title: Mumbai local train stabbing: Suspect arrested as question remains over passenger safety after second incident in June
summary: This month saw two stabbings on Mumbai trains. Mayank Lohar, 22, was killed over a seat dispute, and suspect Sachin Suvarna, arrested after a manhunt, is being interrogated.
